epidemiology: Accounts for 60% of benign ovarian epithelial neoplasms. Most common in women aged 30-50 years.

serous_cystadenoma_features.morphology: Unilocular or multilocular cyst with thin, smooth septa (< 3 mm).
serous_cystadenoma_features.fluid: Anechoic clear fluid with posterior acoustic enhancement.
serous_cystadenoma_features.wall: Smooth outer and inner margins, no papillary projections or solid tissue.
serous_cystadenoma_features.orads_category: O-RADS 2 (if unilocular < 10 cm) or O-RADS 3 (if multilocular < 10 cm or unilocular ≥ 10 cm).

mucinous_cystadenoma_features.morphology: Large, multilocular cyst with multiple locules exhibiting variable internal echogenicity (honeycomb appearance).
mucinous_cystadenoma_features.fluid: Mucinous fluid with fine low-level echoes, dense particulate, or varying brightness across locules.
mucinous_cystadenoma_features.orads_category: O-RADS 3 (if < 10 cm smooth multilocular) or O-RADS 4 (if ≥ 10 cm multilocular).

doppler_characteristics: Color Score 1-2 (Avascular or minimal flow restricted strictly to thin septa). Absence of thick vascularized solid mural nodules.
